g1-implement.title: G1 Diagnose: discriminate (a) misregistration vs (b) under-called caps
g1-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for the DIAGNOSIS gate. Evidence-only; NO production code change. On 1-2 RBR 2023-Q corners (Monaco/VER fast corner is the canonical 3.79x case; add one braking knee), pull the ideal-lap speed trace (PhysicsSimulator canonical path via car_prior.build_car_ceiling), the real best-lap speed, and the ribbon curvature, ALL on TRUE track distance (not normalized progress). Determine whether the 3.3-3.8x ratios come from (a) corner misregistration by resample_by_progress (ideal caps physical; corners drift in distance) or (b) genuinely under-called ideal corner caps (lateral frontier / Gsat fallback too low even when distance-aligned). Concretely: (i) overlay v_ideal, v_real, curvature vs distance; (ii) check the ideal lap's apex/min-speed values are physically plausible for each corner's curvature; (iii) check whether min-speed points line up in distance between ideal and real; (iv) recompute the regime ratio under a true-distance alignment and report whether it falls to <=~1. Deliver .agent-work/522-phase-align-utilization/DIAGNOSIS.md naming (a) or (b) with the trace evidence and a recommended comparison method, plus a reproducible diagnostic script and the figure(s). Wait for and integrate IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.
